latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the A/B Test Setup skill.
- Provides structured guidance for planning, designing, and implementing A/B and multivariate tests.
- Includes best practices for hypothesis creation, variant design, sample size estimation, and metrics selection.
- Offers checklists for test launch, monitoring, and result analysis to ensure statistical rigor.
- Lists common mistakes and links to related resources for further support.
